name: Initia iUSD
oneLiner: iUSD is a single-chain Initia wrapper of bridged Agora AUSD; reserve yield is redirected to ecosystem incentives and redemption routes through AUSD.
collateral: 1:1 reserve in Agora AUSD bridged to Initia via LayerZero; AUSD itself is backed by short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, overnight reverse repos, and cash held in a bankruptcy-remote Delaware Statutory Trust managed by VanEck and custodied by State Street
pegMechanism: iUSD is a single-chain wrapper of bridged Agora AUSD on Initia. Each iUSD is minted against an equal amount of AUSD locked at the Initia LayerZero bridge endpoint; reserve yield from the underlying AUSD is redirected by Initia into ecosystem incentives (Echelon lending, liquidity programs, Cabal vaults) rather than to holders. Holder redemption ultimately depends on the AUSD bridge and Agora's direct USD redemption.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: BLOCKED: the tracked Initia iUSD Move asset and issuer documentation establish its Agora AUSD bridge-backed design, but the reviewed public materials do not provide a current module-level inventory of holder freeze, denylist, or transfer-control authority. The inherited classification is retained for the bridged AUSD exposure; no direct holder-control posture is asserted without verified Move-module authority evidence.

notices.title: New chain, no published proof-of-reserves for the wrapper
notices.message: iUSD lives on Initia, a recently launched Move-based Cosmos L1 with limited operational history. Initia has not yet published a dedicated transparency feed for the AUSD-backed iUSD wrapper; reserve trust currently inherits from Agora's published AUSD attestations plus the LayerZero bridge endpoint. Redemption to USD ultimately routes back through the AUSD bridge to Agora.

reserves.issuerOrObligor: Agora AUSD and the Initia LayerZero AUSD0 OFT

reserveReview.rationale: Initia's official iusd-vault and AUSD0 OFT resources show that iUSD is minted 1:1 only after the local AUSD0 representation is delivered and deposited. The direct reserve dependency is therefore the existing 100% Agora AUSD slice. Agora's reserve report is reviewed on the upstream AUSD record; this wrapper has no separate reserve report.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Initia vault/OFT relationship and documented 1:1 AUSD dependency
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified direct stablecoin dependency remains in the iUSD wrapper path. The underlying AUSD composition and its 3.66% unidentified stablecoin sub-slice remain reviewed on the upstream AUSD asset.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The iUSD wrapper is held through Initia and LayerZero contracts, while reserve custody and assurance are inherited from AUSD. Initia does not publish a dedicated legal custody or proof-of-reserves report for the wrapper, so segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation are not asserted here.

mintAuthority.summary: Initia iUSD is a single-chain wrapper of Agora AUSD bridged via LayerZero; each iUSD is minted on Initia against AUSD locked/burned at the LayerZero bridge endpoint, so supply is controlled by the bridge/OFT route rather than a local CDP or issuer.

controls.label: iusd-vault contract (mints iUSD 1:1 against AUSD0 deposits)
controls.capDescription: iUSD is minted by the iusd-vault contract (0x2981d795...) 1:1 against AUSD0 deposited. There is no fixed token cap: effective capacity rises when more AUSD0 is deposited, while outstanding supply remains bounded by deposited AUSD0. The vault is the only entity that can invoke the mint_ref through the 0xfd6a07 sticky Move object's ExtendRef.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: User bridges AUSD0 via LayerZero OFT (0xf407bc...); OFT mints AUSD0 on Initia; AUSD0 deposited to vault object 0xfd6a07...; vault uses ExtendRef to generate signer for 0xfd6a07 and calls managed_coin::Capabilities to mint iUSD 1:1.
routeChecks.caps: No cap beyond AUSD0 supply deposited. LayerZero DVN/security config not independently resolved. vault::ModuleStore.base_token = AUSD0 (0x8078cf9...).

controls.evidence: Initia REST (rest.initia.xyz): 0xfd6a07594842ac5d7501ff55243aff06e4f991f320828be05a4590970145e90a is a sticky Move Object (ObjectCore.owner = 0x0, non-transferable). vault::VaultAccount.extend_ref stored at iusd-vault contract 0x2981d7952151389d3820c4d4e2602e6ce4e8df7c2675ef88626efa110fa20aa6. Confirmed from tx 4dbe5cba...: OFT LayerZero messaging_composer::ComposeDelivered triggers AUSD0 mint by OFT contract 0xf407bc..., followed by vault MintEvent minting iUSD 1:1. vault module functions are private/friend-only — no external mint path. vault::ModuleStore.admin = self (0x2981d7...).

controls.label: iusd-vault multisig admin (3-of-4)
controls.evidence: At Initia height 19467576, iusd-vault account 0x2981d795... held the native MultisigWallet named 'iusd-vault', threshold 3 (each member weight 1), and 4 voting members: 0xa5a8f716d5..., 0xc24c6072be..., 0x21b8a1fa32..., and 0x6c7034c703... (plus 2 proposers with weight 0). The same account held the package MetadataStore, and its vault module had COMPATIBLE upgrade policy. Because transactions from the publishing account require the 3-of-4 multisig, this control can upgrade mint-critical vault function bodies as well as govern vault configuration; individual AUSD0-backed mints remain automatic and require no vote.

controls.label: AUSD0 LayerZero OFT admin multisig (3-of-5)
controls.evidence: At Initia height 19467576, AUSD0 OFT package object 0xf407bcfb... had ObjectCore.owner = 0x486bc26c... and object_code_deployment::ManagingRefs with arbitrary_signer_enabled = true. All eight package modules had COMPATIBLE upgrade policy, and the object-code deployment ABI exposed get_code_object_signer and upgrade entry points for the owned code object. The owner address was the native 'AUSD0 Multisig - Weighted' wallet with threshold 30 (3-of-5 x weight 10 each), five voting members, and one weight-1 proposer. This proves package-signing control independently of the matching OApp admin/delegate fields: the 3-of-5 multisig can upgrade AUSD0 mint and bridge logic and administer LayerZero OFT routing, but it has no separate direct mint key.

review.evidence: At Initia height 19467576, 0xfd6a07... was a sticky Move Object (owner=0x0, non-transferable); vault::VaultAccount.extend_ref was stored at iusd-vault contract 0x2981d795..., so only the vault could sign for 0xfd6a07 and invoke managed_coin mint. Transaction 4dbe5cba... traced LayerZero OFT AUSD0 minting by 0xf407bc... followed by a 1:1 vault MintEvent for iUSD. The iusd-vault package was COMPATIBLE and published by its native 3-of-4 multisig account. The AUSD0 package was also COMPATIBLE; its code object was owned by native 3-of-5 multisig 0x486bc26c..., and its live ManagingRefs plus the object-code deployment ABI proved that owner could derive the code-object signer and submit upgrades. Supply remained bounded by deposited AUSD0, with no independent free-mint path, while both material package upgrade controllers were identified.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All iUSD is minted on Initia by the iusd-vault against AUSD0 deposited into its sticky vault object. AUSD0 is the LayerZero OFT representation of Agora AUSD, so the exact iUSD deployment inherits the local vault, AUSD0 OFT administration, and LayerZero messaging failure domains.

routes.reviewNote: Composite route: LayerZero delivers AUSD0 to Initia, then the iusd-vault locks the local AUSD0 representation and mints the exact iUSD contract 1:1.
